title: Extract shared VisionWarning component and coverageColor utility
description:
Two extractions from existing code to enable reuse on the Define page:

**1. VisionWarning → shared component**
Create `dashboard/frontend/components/shared/vision-warning.tsx` by extracting the VisionWarning from `DefinePanel.tsx`. Add a `variant` prop: `'card'` (current card-width behavior for landing panel) and `'full'` (full-width for Define page). The full variant stretches to 100% width. Both variants share the same design: dashed border `rgba(239,68,100,0.20)`, gradient bg, red icon, violet CTA.

**2. coverageColor → shared utility**
Move or extract `coverageColor()` from `dashboard/frontend/app/spec-alignment/page.tsx` into `dashboard/frontend/lib/utils/colors.ts` (which already exists per codebase context). Export it from there. Update `spec-alignment/page.tsx` to import from the new location.

Update `DefinePanel.tsx` to import VisionWarning from the shared location instead of having it inline. Update `spec-alignment/page.tsx` to import coverageColor from `lib/utils/colors.ts`.
acceptance_criteria:
- VisionWarning component exists at components/shared/vision-warning.tsx
- VisionWarning accepts variant prop ('card' | 'full')
- DefinePanel.tsx imports VisionWarning from shared location (no duplicate definition)
- coverageColor function exported from lib/utils/colors.ts
- spec-alignment/page.tsx imports coverageColor from lib/utils/colors.ts
- Both components render identically to their pre-extraction behavior
- No type errors in modified files
